business_problem: Greenlane needs to support customers using its high-power commercial fleet charging network with accurate answers while giving complex cases a clear path to human support.
solution_summary: Greenlane uses Salesforce Agentforce for driver and customer support, drawing answers from its existing knowledge base. The company intends Agentforce to act as the primary first responder and solve most cases, with escalation to human support for edge cases. Greenlane also updates knowledge articles when customers describe hardware in their own vernacular so the agent and support staff share the same context. Salesforce lists Service Cloud, Data 360, and Slack among the products used, but the story does not explain their specific roles in this implementation. It reports AI response capability across 106 test scenarios and faster support responses, but the extracted page text omits units for the displayed figures. The source does not describe ingestion tooling, retrieval configuration, storage, or model details.

Our goal is for Agentforce to be the primary first responder that can solve the vast majority of cases, with a route to human support for edge cases when it's needed.
